text: 5:53 am Eau de Toilette Registrado: Mié May 23, 2018 9:27 am Mensajes: 121 Share | Apple Inc's (AAPL.O) stock on Monday jumped 2.3 percent scarpe nike air max 90 , reaching a high not seen since December, after rival Samsung Electronics Co Ltd <005930.KS> suspended production of its flagship Galaxy Note 7 smartphones following reports of fires in replacement devices.Fires in the smartphones that were meant to replace devices that had been recalled because of their propensity to explode could be a disaster for Samsung and a potential boon to Apple.Apple's stock was up $2.66 at $116.72 in afternoon trading and was the largest contributor to gains on the S&P 500. Earlier, Samsung's stock dipped 1.5 percent.Samsung's ongoing problems suggested the world's largest smartphone maker has failed to fix a problem that has already damaged its brand and threatened to derail a recovery in its mobile business.Following the reports of fire in replacement devices, Verizon Communications Inc (VZ.N), AT&T Inc (T.N) and other wireless carriers suspended sales and exchanges of Note 7s.Best Buy Co Inc (BBY.N) will no longer sell the Note 7 and said customers could return their smartphones or exchange them for a different device."We believe the Note 7's ongoing issues could help market share shifts for Apple," Credit Suisse analyst Kulbinder Garcha said in a note to clients on Monday. He estimated that a 5 percent gain in high-end smartphone market share would increase Apple's earnings per share by as much as 7 percent.Apple's stock has rallied 13 percent since mid-September on optimism about demand for the recently launched iPhone 7.Shares are up 30 percent from lows hit in May scarpe nike air max 98 , when fears about weak iPhone demand allowed Google parent Alphabet Inc (GOOGL.O) to briefly eclipse Apple as the world's largest company by market capitalisation.Samsung is the world's largest seller of smartphones by volume, with about 23 percent market share, followed HEGANG, Heilongjiang, July 25 (Xinhua) -- The death toll in a colliery flood in northeast China's Heilongjiang Province has climbed to four as rescuers retrieved two more dead bodies in the shaft Saturday, authorities said.Rescuers are racing to search for the 11 workers who have been trapped in the pit for five days scarpe nike air max tn uomo , the emergency rescue headquarters at Xuxiang Colliery said in a press release.It said rescuers had detected signs of life in the pit, and hoped to find survivors.Flood inundated the pit at around 5 p.m. on July 20, trapping 15 miners. Investigators said the flood was an aftermath of downpour.Zheng Xiupeng, who escaped the flood scene, waited near the entrance to the pit every day. "I have three relatives and several friends down there," he said.Zheng scarpe nike air max tn bianche , 49, was one of the two survivors who escaped without injuries. "I felt something was wrong when strange gales began to blow. Then a young miner rushed out, crying 'run, run'".` Zheng followed him to jump onto a running winch, which took them to safety. "It all happened too fast. I'm sorry I didn't have time to help others. I hope they'll all survive, so that we can still eat and drink together."Hegang is a major coal producer. Xuxiang Colliery is privately owned scarpe nike air max tn nere , with an annual output of 150,000 tonnes.
